summary: Resideo Technologies filed an 8-K covering (i) a subsidiary merger where Resideo Funding Inc. merged into Resideo Funding II LLC with the latter assuming the Notes and Credit Agreement obligations, and (ii) a termination agreement with Honeywell dated June 22, 2026. The filing lacks specifics on the termination's terms or background; the subsidiary merger is a routine internal restructuring. Without details on the Honeywell termination or its significance, this filing does not clearly fit a special-situation category. The event appears administrative, not a standalone special situation. Watch for further disclosure on the Honeywell termination.
